marks.gloss_en: שהיה רבי אליעזר אומר: כל מקום שנאמר זכר ונקבה אתה מוציא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס מביניהם -- and of a bird it is not said
R' Eliezer: a tumtum and an androginos do not render garments impure in the throat
סמי מיכן טומטום (= p_semi_erchin_hazachar)
the baraita: 'the male' (Lev 27:3) -- and not a tumtum or an androginos [in valuations]
תא שמע: יכול ... בערך אשה? ת"ל הזכר ... אם נקבה, ולא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס!
סמי מיכן טומטום (= p_semi_erchin_nekeva)
(entertained by the baraita) they might not be valued as a man but be valued as a woman
תא שמע: אם זכר אם נקבה -- זכר ודאי נקבה ודאית, ולא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס
סמי מיכן טומטום (= p_semi_shelamim)
the baraita: 'whether male or female' (Lev 3:1) -- a definite male, a definite female, and not a tumtum or an androginos
תא שמע: הזכר -- ולא נקבה; 'זכר' below, which need not be said -- להוציא טומטום ואנדרוגינוס
סמי מיכן טומטום (= p_semi_olah)
the baraita: 'a male' -- not a female; when it says 'a male' below, which it need not say, why does it say it? to exclude a tumtum and an androginos

תא שמע: the worshipped ... and a tumtum and androginos all render garments impure in the throat; R' Eliezer: tumtum and androginos do not ... a bird, of which 'male and female' is not said, you do not exclude them! (Steinsaltz: the first tanna treats the tumtum bird as unfit, i.e. not a doubtful male or female)
the baraita's first tanna: the worshipped, the set-aside, the harlot's fee, the dog's price, and a tumtum and an androginos -- all render garments impure in the throat
סמי מיכן טומטום (= p_semi_beit_habliah)
R' Eliezer: and a bird, since 'male and female' is not said of it, you do not exclude a tumtum and an androginos from among them
תא שמע: R' Elazar: tereifa, kilayim, yotze dofen, tumtum and androginos -- not holy and do not sanctify; and Shmuel: in temura
R' Elazar: the tereifa, kilayim, the one born by caesarean, tumtum and androginos -- are not holy and do not sanctify
סמי מיכן טומטום (= p_semi_lo_kedoshim)
and Shmuel said: not holy by substitution, and they do not sanctify to make a substitute
תא שמע: R' Elazar: FIVE are not holy and do not sanctify ... tumtum and androginos. וכי תימא הכא נמי סמי מיכן טומטום -- הוו להו ארבעה! (the deletion answer is pre-empted: the count is five)
אפיק טומטום ועייל יתום (= p_afik_tumtum_ayil_yatom)
R' Elazar: FIVE are not holy and do not sanctify -- the tereifa, kilayim, the caesarean-born, the tumtum and the androginos
R' Ilai in R' Yishmael's name: an androginos is a firstborn, and its blemish is with it

(entertained) the baraita's dispute is over the tumtum: the first tanna holds it a doubt and holy out of doubt; RSBY comes to say it is a distinct entity and not holy (deleting the tumtum would make RSBY the same as the Rabbis)
